
# Christchurch Pulse — #30DayMapChallenge 2026 Day 10

**Theme:** Prompt  
**Location:** Ōtautahi / Christchurch, New Zealand  
**Entire map generated by AI prompt**

An interactive night-time “pulse” map of Christchurch showing bus activity, urban extent, roads, and real Metro route shapes. Built entirely by prompting an AI (Grok) — no manual coding of the map logic.

## What it shows

- Christchurch City Urban Extent (CCC Open Data)
- Street centre lines (clipped to urban extent)
- Real Metro bus routes from Environment Canterbury (clipped)
- Bus stops
- Animated buses moving along real route geometries
- Approximate timetable that changes with time of day
- Moving “heart” representing the density peak of activity
- Time slider to explore the day

## How it was made

This map was created for Day 10 of the #30DayMapChallenge (“Prompt”). The goal was to test how far pure prompting could go:

1. Started with a simple request for a Christchurch version of a cinematic “pulse” map
2. Iteratively refined through conversation: night style, urban extent, roads, real routes, bus stops, timetable, speed, basemap
3. AI wrote the complete self-contained HTML + Leaflet application
4. Data processing (clipping routes to urban extent) was also done via prompted Python scripts
5. Final result is a single HTML file + GeoJSON layers that runs locally or on GitHub Pages

No hand-written map code. The skill being tested was **prompt engineering, data selection, iterative refinement, and spatial judgement** — not traditional GIS scripting.

## Data sources

- CCC DP Christchurch City Urban Extent (Open Data)
- CCC Street Centre Line (Open Data)
- Environment Canterbury Bus Routes (ArcGIS service)
- Bus stops (CCC Open Data)
- Metro Christchurch route information

## Running locally

```bash
python -m http.server 8000
```

Then open http://localhost:8000

## Files

- `index.html` — complete interactive map
- `urban_extent.geojson`
- `roads_clipped.geojson`
- `routes_clipped.geojson`
- `bus_stops.geojson`
